name: DEI lending sAMM spot-oracle liquidation drain
summary: The DEI lending contract priced collateral from the sAMM-USDC/DEI pool's spot balances, so the attacker flash-borrowed 24,772,798 DEI out of that same pool to crash the reported collateral value, liquidated the newly insolvent users through helper contract 0xb8f5c9e18abbb21dfa4329586ee74f1e2b685009, burned the seized LP for 5,218,173 USDC plus DEI, and kept 3,001,552.4990983484 DEI after repaying the flash loans.

loss.notes: Exact receipt accounting: net 3001552.4990983484 DEI into the attack contract across the flash-loan, liquidation, LP-burn, and swap steps, with USDC and LP legs netting to zero in-tx. DEI still held its $1 peg at the incident timestamp, and the attacker subsequently bridged 3m USDC via Multichain, converting to 200,000 DAI plus 1,101.8 ETH (about $3.1m) before Tornado Cash, corroborating par. The team reimbursed liquidated users, so the protocol absorbed the loss. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.

ageReset.description: Directly deployed DEI lending runtime pricing collateral from sAMM-USDC/DEI spot balances since creation. No proxy code-selection path; the runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

sources.note: Anchor: 0xe374495036fac18aa5b1a497a17e70f256c4d3d416dd1408c026f3f5c70a3a9c (Fantom block 33466614:14, 2022-03-15T06:19:46Z) is the single exploit transaction, sent by EOA 0x1ed5112b32486840071b7cdd2584ded2c66198dd to attack contract 0xb8f5c9e18abbb21dfa4329586ee74f1e2b685009. Receipt Transfer aggregation shows net 3001552.4990983484 DEI into the attack contract, matching the published 3,001,552 DEI profit; the USDC, sAMM-USDC/DEI, and sex-sAMM legs all net to zero in-tx as flash-loan and burn intermediaries. Deployer 0xfe351f5ed699fd5ea80b906f89dfdad2f885a46c created the lending contract directly and is unrelated to the attacker; no compromised-key path is evidenced, the liquidations executed through the contract's own spot-price accounting. Age: the lending runtime was created in 0xacbab5cc2b08a2e06caa8f39789d378dc01ec7ac08c133c2b8633c6427179c22 at block 33323394:6 (deployment block found by getCode binary search after FTMScan API proved unreachable); no EIP-1967 implementation slot is set and the runtime hashes 0x065e199b4b1befe167352d9f4ecab8a7dbb69a9737f0fd5616b446241837bd74 identically at deployment and pre-exploit, giving 1647325186 minus 1647182493 equals 142693 seconds.
